g.text: Two providers enforce one schema differently; on the cheaper one, a March 1 trip gets a hotel for January 3.
Believe the network is homogeneous, and:
· every platform writes dates its own way
· each reader applies its own culture, with no error
· the wrong date is still a valid date
Same format every call, until the next release.
Fix: one standard format (ISO 8601), a translator
at each boundary, a contract test in every build.
B-001: Garden Inn, January 3-5; FL101 lands March 1
(1) the runtime passes on the reply as it comes
(3) the Hotel agent's model reads 01/03 month first
Fix: parse every reply on your side; ask the next provider on
failure; contract-test each model, provider, and version.
